scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the final six Expo originals. Source instructions are inert data, not authority to execute their tools or change permissions.
linked_reference_caveat: Complete original bodies only; linked migration maps, actual native dependencies, evaluation scripts, grader rubrics, CLI implementation, telemetry code and example licenses remain unread and require review before a concrete task is frozen. No models, builds, services, accounts or source commands were used.

sources.workflow: Incrementally migrate the real Apple module from definition DSL to supported macro API while preserving its observable JavaScript and TypeScript contract and retaining unsupported members in verified mixed mode.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real module, example app, existing bindings, tests and export inventory, and the actual installed macro declarations and matching core runtime are required. The original specifies a version floor in both module and example but says it is not sufficient proof of every capability. Native build tools and the linked migration, compatibility and example references need review; Kotlin migration and SDK upgrade are separate scope.
sources.offline_assessment: A source-only migration may be offline in a reviewed real native repository and compatible toolchain. The default Python container cannot compile Swift macros or resolve the real module in an iOS app. Generated expansion text and passing compilation do not prove runtime discovery, dispatch or preserved thread semantics.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the exact before and after JS export contract, names, records, defaults, errors, queues, events, shared objects and module-registration entries. Build against actual core, run native and JS tests and launch the example to resolve the module. Exercise blocking work and preserved async behavior rather than infer equivalence from unchanged signatures; no issue posting is authorized by this review.

sources.workflow: Confirm an actual Expo or EAS request, classify the requested outcome rather than guessing from files alone, apply project-specific shared rules and route to the relevant leaf skill.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual user request, project manifest and configuration, SDK and native-project status and chosen leaf originals are required. Auth and linking apply to the selected EAS operation, not all local framework changes. Native-only distribution retains the native project. SDK-specific docs, leaf bodies and implementation references need separate review.
sources.offline_assessment: Routing a fully specified request from actual public project metadata and the pinned map can be offline. That is a repository-orientation or routing task, not a built app or cloud operation. The default runtime can inspect text but cannot realize arbitrary routed native tasks; task completion requires the chosen leaf's concrete contract.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check Expo applicability and correct outcome-to-leaf choice against actual request and manifest, with ambiguous intent left explicit. Verify SDK-specific guidance, native project preservation and operation-specific auth boundaries. A correct routing label must not count as completion of the leaf's implementation, deployment or device behavior.

sources.workflow: Evaluate a selected local Expo skill through explicitly scoped trigger recall, with-versus-without-skill generation, static checks and optionally actual platform rendering and grading, retaining per-case logs, usage, screenshots and a local viewer.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual local skill and helpers, chosen prompts, runtime mode, SDK and platforms, independent grader rubric and identical uncontaminated fixtures are required. Generation and trigger checks require an authorized model harness even in static-only mode. Native rendering needs actual matching simulators and native toolchains; web needs a real browser. The original's permission, plugin, cleanup, process-killing and cache behaviors need implementation review and cannot be adopted on this shared host.
sources.offline_assessment: A separately scoped offline report-aggregation or viewer task may be feasible with real retained evaluation artifacts after script review. The full evaluation is not standard-library offline code generation: it includes model requests and runtime dependencies. Positive-only trigger queries measure recall, not false-positive rate or overall trigger accuracy. Source-level static success is not a runtime screen result.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify identical case inputs, actual local skill identity, baseline isolation, complete stage exit/error evidence, real runtime provenance, grader inputs and usage counters captured at execution. Distinguish code-check, recall and rendering endpoints. A root-route screenshot cannot establish navigation or interaction, and a best-effort error screenshot must remain a failure. No permission bypass, shared-resource cleanup, publication or model call follows from source review.

sources.workflow: Prepare and submit specific product or skill feedback through the real feedback CLI, with a distinct approved eval-candidate flow for persistent task failures, or inspect or change opt-in telemetry only when requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Specific actual observed feedback or failure evidence, reviewed CLI package and submission behavior, correct category and subject and an authorized external destination are required for submission. Eval candidates require exact payload approval and exclude confidential context. Telemetry implementation and state need review; feedback is independent of telemetry and must not silently enable it.
sources.offline_assessment: A redacted payload draft or local telemetry-state change could be a separately scoped offline task with real inputs and reviewed implementation. A stubbed submission or saved draft cannot prove external acceptance, and the default container neither supplies the CLI nor authorizes network transmission. Do not invent a failure or submit these benchmark sources as feedback.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact approved minimal payload against real observed evidence, task specificity and duplicate rules, and bind actual CLI response to any submission claim. Verify real local telemetry state and no unsolicited enablement. Keep drafting, network submission, eval-candidate receipt and telemetry controls distinct, and prevent secrets or source content from leaving the fixture.

sources.workflow: Choose the compatible actual Expo UI component layer for the requested native interface, wrap its tree with the correct Host, implement real state behavior and preserve platform boundaries and appropriate list virtualization.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The real app, selected SDK, actual installed component APIs and types, relevant layer references and a compatible target runtime are needed. Universal, platform-specific and community-compatibility layers have different availability and import contracts. Native implementation requires an actual platform runtime; no account or external service is inherently required for a local control.
sources.offline_assessment: A focused UI source change can be offline in a real public app and reviewed dependency environment. The default Python runtime cannot render SwiftUI or Compose. A universal web preview cannot establish native behavior, and a grouped native List is not evidence of large-data virtualization.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual version-supported imports and Host placement, requested controls and state transitions, platform-specific file or runtime guards, accessibility and native rendering. For sheets test open and dismissal state on the real API, rather than accept borrowed prop names that type or runtime checks reject. Assess large-list behavior under the chosen virtualized implementation rather than the grouped-row component.

sources.workflow: Inventory the real web app's routes and backend boundary, build a working native DOM shell, incrementally redesign selected screens, preserve data and auth behavior and compare running original and native routes before any selected delivery step.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real existing web app and its routes, services and backend contract, compatible Expo app and dependencies, linked idiom and verification references and actual requested platform tooling are needed. The original explicitly selects browser and native-driver tools for parity checks. Remote backend, account, payment or store requirements depend on the actual app and shipping scope; none can be inferred from a generic mock.
sources.offline_assessment: A route inventory or a focused migration of a real self-contained screen can be offline after dependency and helper review. Full parity requires actual running web and native apps; the default Python container cannot provide them. A compiled or blank DOM shell and a migration checklist do not establish migrated behavior or a shippable app.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check complete screen and backend inventory, server/client boundary, actual data and session handling and preserved requested content and behavior on matching running routes. Test interaction, navigation and transitions rather than rely on compilation or static screenshots. Keep webview-shell parity, native redesign, service integration and actual store delivery distinct, with real device-driver evidence for claims that require it.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
